Biological_Interpretation: AD is associated with broad molecular remodeling.
Coordinated reduction of neuronal and synaptic functional programs.
Reduced molecular machinery associated with neurotransmission.
Increased cellular response to metal-associated stress.
Potential alteration of cellular transport processes.
Potential alteration of lipid metabolic processes.
ABCD1 links the two discovery-derived pathway signals.
Synaptic/neuronal abnormalities are more robust than the ABCD1-centered pathway hypothesis.
